part1/batch-delete: Request payload for batch deletion of resources, given as a list of resource URIs, local IDs or unique identifiers (UIDs).
part1/batch-response: Response describing the outcome of a batch create, update or delete operation, reporting the per-item result of each request.
part1/deployed-system: A deployed System (GeoJSON encoding, a profile of the OGC API - Features feature): a system as listed within a Deployment, tying it to its installation in that deployment.
part1/deployed-system-array: Bare JSON array of deployed System resources (GeoJSON encoding), used as the request payload for batch creation or update of several resources at once.
part1/deployed-system-array-sensorml: Bare JSON array of deployed System resources (SensorML encoding), used as the request payload for batch creation or update of several resources at once.
part1/deployed-system-collection: Paged collection of deployed System resources (GeoJSON encoding) as returned by list queries, with the items plus navigation `links`.
part1/deployed-system-collection-sensorm: Paged collection of deployed System resources (SensorML encoding) as returned by list queries, with the items plus navigation `links`.
part1/deployed-system-sensorml: A deployed System (SensorML 3.0 JSON encoding): a system as listed within a Deployment, tying it to its installation in that deployment.
part1/deployment: A Deployment (GeoJSON encoding, a profile of the OGC API - Features feature): the installation of one or more systems at a location and time, describing where and when they operate.
part1/deployment-array: Bare JSON array of Deployment resources (GeoJSON encoding), used as the request payload for batch creation or update of several resources at once.
part1/deployment-array-sensorml: Bare JSON array of Deployment resources (SensorML encoding), used as the request payload for batch creation or update of several resources at once.
part1/deployment-collection: Paged collection of Deployment resources (GeoJSON encoding) as returned by list queries, with the items plus navigation `links`.
part1/deployment-collection-sensorml: Paged collection of Deployment resources (SensorML encoding) as returned by list queries, with the items plus navigation `links`.
part1/deployment-sensorml: A Deployment (SensorML 3.0 JSON encoding): the installation of one or more systems at a location and time, describing where and when they operate.
part1/feature: Generic GeoJSON feature used as the base of the Connected Systems feature resources, with local `id`, `geometry`, `bbox`, free-form `properties` and `links`.
part1/links: Collection (array) of link objects pointing to related resources, following the OGC API Common link model.
part1/procedure: A Procedure (GeoJSON encoding, a profile of the OGC API - Features feature): a specification of how observations are made or commands are executed, such as a sensor datasheet, method or protocol that systems implement.
part1/procedure-array: Bare JSON array of Procedure resources (GeoJSON encoding), used as the request payload for batch creation or update of several resources at once.
part1/procedure-array-sensorml: Bare JSON array of Procedure resources (SensorML encoding), used as the request payload for batch creation or update of several resources at once.
part1/procedure-collection: Paged collection of Procedure resources (GeoJSON encoding) as returned by list queries, with the items plus navigation `links`.
part1/procedure-collection-sensorml: Paged collection of Procedure resources (SensorML encoding) as returned by list queries, with the items plus navigation `links`.
part1/procedure-sensorml: A Procedure (SensorML 3.0 JSON encoding): a specification of how observations are made or commands are executed, such as a sensor datasheet, method or protocol that systems implement.
part1/property-array-sensorml: Bare JSON array of Property resources (SensorML encoding), used as the request payload for batch creation or update.
part1/property-collection-sensorml: Paged collection of Property resources (SensorML encoding) as returned by list queries, with the items plus navigation `links`.
part1/property-sensorml: A Property (SensorML 3.0 JSON encoding): a definition of an observable or controllable property (e.g. temperature, wind speed) that systems and procedures can reference.
part1/sampling-feature: A Sampling Feature (GeoJSON encoding): a feature such as a station, specimen or transect that is sampled or observed by systems, and serves as the feature of interest of observations; profile of the OGC API - Features feature.
part1/sampling-feature-array: Bare JSON array of Sampling Feature resources (GeoJSON encoding), used as the request payload for batch creation or update.
part1/sampling-feature-collection: Paged collection of Sampling Feature resources (GeoJSON encoding) as returned by list queries, with the items plus navigation `links`.
part1/system: A System (GeoJSON encoding, a profile of the OGC API - Features feature): a sensor, actuator, platform, sampler or other asset that produces observations or receives commands, with its identity, type and relationships to other resources.
part1/system-array: Bare JSON array of System resources (GeoJSON encoding), used as the request payload for batch creation or update of several resources at once.
part1/system-array-sensorml: Bare JSON array of System resources (SensorML encoding), used as the request payload for batch creation or update of several resources at once.
part1/system-collection: Paged collection of System resources (GeoJSON encoding) as returned by list queries, with the items plus navigation `links`.
part1/system-collection-sensorml: Paged collection of System resources (SensorML encoding) as returned by list queries, with the items plus navigation `links`.
part1/system-sensorml: A System (SensorML 3.0 JSON encoding): a sensor, actuator, platform, sampler or other asset that produces observations or receives commands, with its identity, type and relationships to other resources.
part1/uris: Enumerations of the allowed type URIs (from the SSN/SOSA and Connected Systems vocabularies) for System, Deployment and Procedure features.
part2/base-stream: Properties shared by DataStream and ControlStream resources: local ID, name, description, valid time and the list of supported encoding formats.
part2/command: A Command: a request sent through a ControlStream to a System to perform an action, carrying its parameters, issue time and execution constraints.
part2/command-collection: Paged collection of Command resources as returned by list queries, with the items plus navigation `links`.
part2/command-result: A CommandResult: a result resource produced by the execution of a Command, linked to it by `command@id` and carrying inline data or a reference to the result.
part2/command-result-collection: Paged collection of CommandResult resources as returned by list queries, with the items plus navigation `links`.
part2/command-schema: Schema describing the content of commands in a ControlStream; the syntax depends on the command format (JSON, SWE, Protobuf or other).
part2/command-schema-any-other: Command schema for any other command format, identified by `commandFormat` and carrying free-form schema properties.
part2/command-schema-json: Command schema for the JSON format (`application/json`), defining the `parametersSchema` and optional result and feasibility result schemas with SWE Common components.
part2/command-schema-protobuf: Command schema for the Protobuf format, describing command parameters using a Protobuf message definition.
part2/command-schema-swe: Command schema for SWE Common encodings (text, binary, etc.), giving the record schema and encoding rules of the command stream.
part2/command-status: A CommandStatus report: the state of execution of a Command at a given report time, with status code, percent completion, message and any results.
part2/command-status-code: Enumeration of the status codes a Command can report, such as pending, accepted, executing, completed, failed or rejected.
part2/command-status-collection: Paged collection of CommandStatus reports as returned by list queries, with the items plus navigation `links`.
part2/control-stream: A ControlStream: a channel through which commands are sent to a controllable System, describing the supported command parameters, result schema and formats.
part2/control-stream-collection: Paged collection of ControlStream resources as returned by list queries, with the items plus navigation `links`.
part2/control-stream-create: Create payload for a ControlStream: the ControlStream properties plus the required `schema` (command schema) describing the content of its commands.
part2/data-stream: A DataStream: a time-ordered stream of observations produced by a System, describing the observed properties, result schema and formats. Observations are posted to and retrieved from it.
part2/data-stream-collection: Paged collection of DataStream resources as returned by list queries, with the items plus navigation `links`.
part2/data-stream-create: Create payload for a DataStream: the DataStream properties plus the required `schema` (observation schema) describing the content of its observations.
part2/data-stream-schema-def: Schema definition of the observation record of a DataStream, describing phenomenon time, result time, feature of interest, result and parameters with SWE Common components.
part2/observation: An Observation: the result of observing a property of a feature of interest at a given time, produced by a System and stored in a DataStream.
part2/observation-collection: Paged collection of Observation resources as returned by list queries, with the items plus navigation `links`.
part2/observation-schema: Schema describing the content of observations in a DataStream; the syntax depends on the observation format (JSON, SWE, Protobuf or other).
part2/observation-schema-any-other: Observation schema for any other observation format, identified by `obsFormat` and carrying free-form schema properties.
part2/observation-schema-json: Observation schema for the JSON format (`application/json`), describing the observation result, parameters and related fields with SWE Common components.
part2/observation-schema-protobuf: Observation schema for the Protobuf format, describing the observation record using a Protobuf message definition.
part2/observation-schema-swe: Observation schema for SWE Common encodings (text, binary, etc.), giving the record schema and the encoding rules of the observation stream.
part2/system-event: A SystemEvent: a time-stamped event in the life of a System (e.g. calibration, maintenance, deployment or failure), stored as a feature-like record with links.
part2/system-event-collection: Paged collection of SystemEvent resources as returned by list queries, with the items plus navigation `links`.
